correctness.rationale: The Grassmannian line chart over X0≠0 has exact coefficient ideal generated by b_j−j t^(j−1)u and u² from the Hankel minors; the second chart is likewise k[s,w]/(w²). Changing the line basis on their overlap yields s=t^(-1), w=−t^(d−2)u, the actual nontrivial nilradical gluing O_P1(d−2) in every characteristic, not just locally two disjoint dual-number product charts. The Plücker restriction O_P1(d) and short exact sequence produce Hilbert polynomial 2dn+d and h0(O)=d. Independent Groebner ideal containment in d=3,4,5 and overlap arithmetic support, but do not replace, the all-degree argument.
